prompt: Our staff use personal phones for email, everyone works from home, and everything we run is in Microsoft 365 and AWS. What's in scope for Cyber Essentials?
assertions: Cloud services (M365, AWS) are IN scope and cannot be excluded — with the shared-responsibility split by SaaS/IaaS and the customer always owning user access control/MFA enablement
BYOD phones accessing organisational data/email are IN scope (out only if used solely for calls/texts/MFA apps)

Home working devices are in scope; home ISP routers are OUT of scope with the device's software firewall as the boundary; organisation-supplied home routers are in; corporate VPN moves the boundary to the corporate/virtual/cloud firewall
States that MFA is mandatory on all cloud services (and an auto-fail if missing where available)

Notes scope-declaration mechanics under the current requirements: whole-organisation preferred, sub-sets need firewall/VLAN segregation and justified exclusions, and whole-org scope is required for the bundled insurance
